headline: Danganronpa 2x2 January 14
title: Danganronpa 2x2 Release Date January 14 | Slayhem Mode | Gaming News
video_script: Danganronpa two by two arrives on January fourteenth, twenty twenty seven, after a delay from twenty twenty six. It is a remake of Danganronpa two, Goodbye Despair, on Switch 2, Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series and PC. It has an Original mode and a brand new Slayhem mode with a different storyline. Which mode first? Comment below!
description: Danganronpa 2x2 (Spike Chunsoft) launches January 14, 2027 on Switch 2, Switch, PS5, Xbox Series and PC; includes Original and new Slayhem modes. Sources: Gematsu, RPG Site, Automaton.
